description: This file implements memory mapping functions (git_mmap and git_munmap) for use within the git project, providing portable wrappers over system mmap and munmap functionality.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Allocates memory and maps a file into memory with validation for correct usage based on build configurations.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Frees memory previously allocated for mapped regions.

ctags.name: git_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^void *git_mmap(void *start, size_t length, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t offset)$/
ctags.signature: (void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
